_README: Your own commentary for the quarterly report. Key each quarter as it appears in the page URL (e.g. '26Q3' for July–September 2026). Each quarter is a list: every entry becomes its own point in 'The quarter in brief', after the generated ones, on both /quarterly and the PDF. Only 'commentary' is required; it supports markdown (**bold**, *italic*, [links](https://mergers.fyi/phase-2)). 'author' is shown after the point. Keys starting with '_' are ignored.

_example.commentary: More of the same: more deals notified, high clearance rates and longer timeframes. See the [Phase 2 tracker](https://mergers.fyi/phase-2) for the matters still running.
_example.author: Your Name
